propositions: git commit --amend -F/--amend -m replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amend with -F from a fresh -F commit, so it cannot preserve Change-Id in the hook layer
a make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must amend HEAD with FILE's contents while preserving the existing Change-Id from the current HEAD commit
make amend-msg must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD has no Change-Id, rather than silently amending and allowing a fresh Change-Id to be stamped
AGENTS.md documentation must be updated to name make amend-msg as the path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly state that --amend -m/-F drop Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
the solution follows prior art from Go, OpenStack, Android, and Chromium projects that provide wrappers to prevent the failure mode outright rather than detecting it
